title: the fast module crashes or accepts wrong input where the regular module refuses it
author: Claude-JG
description: The test suite with exudynCPPfast stopped at symbolicFunctionTest with a segmentation fault, and 10 models failed for reasons other than rounding: user checks of the symbolic module (esym.Function, the sizes of vector and matrix operands, Diff of a component, EvaluateJacobian, the recording) and of MainSystem (a configuration of a system that is not assembled, RaiseIfNotConsistent...) are CHECKandTHROW, which the fast module compiles out - so an out-of-range write or a crash instead of the error; a FEM mesh stored with a pickled exudyn.exudynCPP enum could not be loaded with the fast module (pybind11 type registered twice). Decided: those checks by PyError or ThrowPyErrorType, as CODING_STYLE.md section 10.1 requires; the name exudyn.exudynCPP resolves to the fast module when it is loaded; revision2026c step RG20.7.6.
releaseNotes: The checks of the input to exudyn.symbolic that the tests reach - esym.Function, the sizes of the operands of vector and matrix operations, Diff, the derivative of an operation without one, Evaluate and EvaluateJacobian, what a recording must not do, a variable outside mbs.symbolicVariables - raise by PyError, and the MainSystem checks of a configuration and of a system not assembled by ThrowPyErrorType: the fast module, which compiles CHECKandTHROW out, crashed or computed with wrong sizes. With the fast module, the name exudyn.exudynCPP resolves to it, so that a pickle naming it loads.
